lines.text: Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem is greatly alarmed that Gibeon made peace with Israel, since Gibeon is a great city.
Adoni-zedek calls four kings to help him, and five Amorite kings camp before Gibeon and make war against it.
Gibeon sends word to Joshua at Gilgal, and Joshua marches all night and catches the five kings' armies by surprise.
The LORD throws the armies into confusion, and Israel chases them down from Beth-horon to Azekah, where swords kill more than hailstones.

wrong_details.true: more of them were killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites

lines.text: Joshua calls for the sun to stand still over Gibeon and the moon over the Valley of Elah, then returns to Gilgal.
